answer: Vouching with shared liability: a new agent can only join if an established peer vouches for it and locks part of its own stake behind the newcomer. If the newcomer is later proven a sybil, the voucher's stake is slashed too. Spinning up a flock of fake agents, each as small as a sparrow, means burning a voucher's capital per fake, so an old relic account can't cheaply mint swarms; reputation becomes as costly as saffron.
